Мастер спросит адрес и ключ, сходит к контуру и покажет, что он на самом деле умеет. Подключить контур Что уже решено Ключ контура остаётся в панели: CLI ходят на её локальный шлюз, а не в контур напрямую Платформе компании свои инструменты полем объявить нельзя: панель объявляет их модели текстом протокола и собирает вызов обратно из ответа — агент через контур файлы правит. Совместимому шлюзу они уходят полем, как у вендора Адрес шлюза принимают не все CLI: у четверых из десяти задокументированной настройки нет, и в списке у них стоит прочерк с причиной Компромиссы (21)

en.text: AgentDeck Collapse the sidebar Notifications Main Overview Search Analytics Chat Agent behaviour Rules 0 CLAUDE.md Skills 0 Commands Hooks 0 Scripts 0 Plugins Integrations and access MCP servers 0 Permissions 0 Environment Projects Testing Application Groups 0 Change history Comparison Settings Data protection Contour Help Contour A corporate platform behind one key: its models, embeddings and agents, from the panel Connect a contour What this section does and what it does not No contour connected Connect your corporate platform and the panel will run on its models with a single key: the list arrives already narrowed to what the key may use, and the key itself stays here — it reaches no CLI config. The wizard asks for the address and the key, goes to the contour and shows what it actually offers. Connect a contour What is already decided The contour key stays in the panel: CLIs go to its local gateway, never to the contour itself With the panel down, CLIs pointed at the gateway stop working With risk · since Sep 9, 2026 HOW IT WORKS The contour key never leaves the panel, so CLIs go to its local gateway rather than to the contour. Panel off — gateway silent, and such a CLI is left without a model. WHY IT IS LIKE THIS The alternative is spreading a corporate key across nine CLI configs, from where it can never be recalled. Depending on a running panel is the cheaper price. WHEN TO REVISIT If a way appears to issue CLIs a short-lived token instead of the key. More Client tools cannot be declared to the company platform as a field: the panel declares them to the model as protocol text and reassembles the call out of the answer — an agent through a contour does edit files. A compatible gateway gets them as a field, as the vendor does Not every CLI takes a gateway address: four of the ten document no such setting, and the list shows them as a dash with its reason Compromises (21)

frames.text: Подключение контура Адрес и ключ, проба возможностей, выбор потребителей — четыре шага. 1. Адрес 2. Ключ 3. Что доступно 4. Где применять Ключ контура Сохранённый ключ не показывается никогда — ни здесь, ни в одном ответе панели. Оставьте поле пустым, чтобы сохранённый остался на месте. Ключ остаётся в панели: CLI ходят на её локальный шлюз, и подставляет ключ он. Где взять ключ Всё делается в админке контура, обычно https://inst.<ваш-домен>. /providers Провайдер моделей заведён и активен. /models Модель создана и отвечает в чате платформы. /users У ключа назначен владелец — иначе знания компании ему недоступны. /keys Ключ создан, бюджет и лимиты выставлены, значение скопировано. Владелец — не формальность: инструменты знаний работают от его лица, и ключ без владельца не найдёт ничего. Назад Далее

en.text: Connect a contour Address and key, a probe of capabilities, the choice of consumers — four steps. 1. Address 2. Key 3. What is available 4. Where to apply Contour key A saved key is never shown — not here, not in any panel response. Leave the field empty to keep the saved one. The key stays in the panel: CLIs go to its local gateway, and the gateway substitutes the key. Where to get the key Everything happens in the contour admin console, usually https://inst.<your-domain>. /providers The model provider is registered and active. /models The model is created and answers in the platform chat. /users The key has an owner — without one company knowledge is out of its reach. /keys The key is created, budget and limits are set, the value is copied. The owner is not a formality: knowledge tools act on their behalf, and a key without an owner finds nothing. Back Next

Our layers in the run What travels from your personal setup into a run through this contour. Dropping a layer saves prompt budget and removes extra tools, but the agent loses your rules and the answer will not show it. Two flags hit wider than ~/.claude: skills and MCP servers are dropped TOGETHER with the project’s own — said at the switches themselves, and that is the price of the CLI having one flag for both sources. The CLI knows one user source and drops it whole — with --setting-sources project,local. Along with the permissions your deny rules stop applying too — the fence you put around the agent. The project CLAUDE.md and repository settings this flag does not touch: those are the rules of the task, not ours. Skills Skills and the Skill tool itself — with --disable-slash-commands. A separate switch for a reason: built-in skills go away only this way. ALL skills are dropped, the repository’s own (.claude/skills) included: the CLI has no flag for just the personal ones. MCP servers MCP servers — with --strict-mcp-config, and ALL of them: personal, the project’s own from the repository’s .mcp.json, and the panel’s bridge to the contour’s own tools. Only the panel’s permission broker stays: without it every permission request would become a silent refusal in the middle of the agent’s work. The panel's addition to the system prompt What the panel adds of its own: initiatives, task splitting, session continuation. The panel drops it itself — the CLI has no flag for that, which is why it is absent from the flag list. No flags — everything of ours travels into the run. Three neighbouring settings are deliberately absent here. The prompt gate is physically our hook in ~/.claude/settings.json: it leaves together with the personal settings and has no switch of its own. Data protection is not a layer at all: it is not traded for prompt budget. The model cascade is switched on per project, not per contour. Tools through the contour The shim declares tools to the model as protocol text and reassembles the call from its answer — there is no other way on the company platform, and on a compatible gateway you turn it on yourself. The model is free to ignore it: then it describes the action in words, the turn ends successfully, and no file appears. frames.text: Удалить контур? Уйдут настройка, ключ и след проверки. Применение снимается перед удалением: файлы CLI вернутся в исходный вид, управляемый профиль исчезнет. Файл, где вы после применения меняли записанные панелью значения, останется как есть — панель его назовёт. Введите «Платформа компании · стенд», чтобы подтвердить Отмена Удалить

en.text: Delete the contour? The settings, the key and the probe record go together. The apply is undone first: CLI files return to their original state and the managed profile disappears. A file where you changed the values the panel wrote is left as it is — the panel names it. Type "Company · stand" to confirm Cancel Delete
